_help: Edit this file when the roster or the hero pools change. 'pool' tiers: primary, secondary, practice. 'avoid' heroes are scored down. 'tier_roles' picks which Icy Veins tier list role applies to the player (Blaze is S as an Offlaner but D as a Tank). Evidence numbers (NGS this season, Storm League) are added by build_playbook.py; do not type records here.
high_damage_note: Teams with exactly two real damage dealers (2,400+ hero damage a minute) are 37-23 in Division C West S22.

notes.Sylvanas: 58% over 119 Storm League games in the last year, 62% in the last 6 months, 2 deaths or fewer wins 79%. A structure and camp hero, not a wave clearer.
notes.Junkrat: 56.7% in Storm League but CCS and Cosmos ban it, so do not plan around it.
notes.Hanzo: 45.9% over 268 games, 41% in the last 6 months.
notes.Li-Ming: 41.7% in Storm League. It won Battlefield of Eternity on Oct 6, so it is not banned forever.
notes.Raynor: Only 8 games in the last year. Practice before using.

notes.Tychus: NGS 7-2 this season with 0.7 deaths a game.
notes.Thrall: NGS 3-1, 7-2 in the HealsOnly team games.
notes.Sylvanas: 5-2 in HealsOnly team games but 0-1 in NGS (4 deaths). Only if Hunter is off it.
notes.Tassadar: Lowest deaths on the roster (1.0), a strong Tomb clearer.
notes.Gul'dan: Highest damage (5.4k a minute) but 3.0 deaths.

notes.Blaze: Counted as MELEE in all ranged counts. S tier as an offlaner on most maps (D only as a tank).
notes.Leoric: Counters Anub'arak and Johanna on paper; A tier offlaner on Garden, Dragon Shire and Volskaya.

notes.Muradin: NGS 4-0, 0.8 deaths. But 47.5% career in Storm League, so a small sample.
notes.Johanna: NGS 4-3, 60% recent in Storm League. Valkamer (CCS) is 5-1 on it, so we usually ban it against CCS.
NGS 2-2 with 2.8 deaths. Listed Qhira counter but went 1/6/7 alone in the front on Garden.

notes.Brightwing: NGS 8-4. CCS is 3-6 against Brightwing or Anduin teams and 9-0 against any other healer.
